name: 29040 · Dalzell, SC
findings: ZIP 29040 (Dalzell) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 4 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 3 organizations.
